account: In its submission to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), current as of June 2025, NT Health proposes an analysis that combines a Bayesian hierarchical model and Power BI AI features to infer ear-disease patterns from health and social data in the Northern Territory. The existing mapping and the seasonal rules written in DAX, the Power BI formula language, are conventional data processing. The intended AI contribution is better identification of the areas that need services. The submission does not fully specify the AI implementation. On 11 August 2025 the Northern Territory Health Minister announced that the tool covers 93 communities and outstations and that NT Hearing Services would next run the AI algorithms, with the map expected to be complete by 2026. In a poster at the World Congress of Audiology on 25 May 2026, the team reported that the mapping phase was complete and that it was still selecting AI tools for modeling. No source reports that the AI analysis was run or that it improved a service or a hearing result.

ai_role.statement: The ITU entry names a Bayesian hierarchical model and Power BI AI features, but the team's 2025 and 2026 abstracts report that the AI tools were still being selected. The completed work is a community-level map and data linkage, which are not AI functions.
